The second finding's premise that src/core/config.ts writes the markers was refuted by grep: config.ts's HTML markers are only read by legacy-cleanup; the bash and zsh completion installers write '# OPENSPEC:START' into rc files.

resolutions.title: The install-command rule rejects a sentence-ending period that the token rule accepts
resolutions.action: one fix with the external pass's suffix finding: install targets are parsed by installTargets(), whose ref runs from '#v<digit>' to the next whitespace, quote, backtick, parenthesis or bracket with a sentence-ending mark stripped; the install-command rule requires a target preceded by 'npm install -g ' whose whole ref is v<version>. The reviewer's suggested lookahead was not used, because it still accepts '#v2.0.1-missing'. Tests: a sentence-ending command passes; mutation to a version-only ref turned two tests red, reverted
